nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'public-launch-readiness' with goal: Prepare Context Crystal for Public Developer Alpha Release

Drafted install.sh and .github/workflows/release.yml based on ~/git/first blueprint; isolated worktree ready at ../ccrystal-worktrees/public-prep; awaiting approval to create files and begin paragraph-by-paragraph README review.

Implemented Stream 1 in isolated worktree ../ccrystal-worktrees/public-prep: install.sh with POSIX sh compatibility and atomic inode replacement, plus .github/workflows/release.yml for automated multi-arch Thin LTO binary compilation. Verified with shellcheck and committed cleanly.

Completed Stream 2 editorial review: standardized dynamic MCP resource URIs uniformly to ccrystal:// across handler, tests, docs, and AGENTS.md; documented /hydrate endpoint and curl installer quickstart in README.md; passed all unit tests, scalafmt, markdownlint, and shellcheck.

Concluded public-launch-readiness track: all 3 streams complete. install.sh and .github/workflows/release.yml implemented, ccrystal:// URI scheme standardized, 3-filter editorial audit of documentation complete, all linters and tests passed, worktrees torn down, and main fast-forward merged and pushed to github and origin.
Public alpha release preparation successfully concluded: release packaging, ccrystal:// URI standardization, and 3-filter editorial documentation audit verified and live on main.
